issues.description: The UML/problem statement defines `Pneumatic.raisePressure(pressureIncrease: int): void`, but the solution declares `void raisePressure(double pressureIncrease)` in `Pneumatic`. This changes the required method signature and would cause compilation/test failures for implementations following the UML (or vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution (and any tests) to match the UML: change `Pneumatic.raisePressure` to `void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease);` and adjust all implementing classes accordingly.
